name: 3W Clinic Collagen & Luxury Gold Revitalizing Comfort Gold Essence 24k Gold 150ml | Korea
description:
Marine collagen and hyaluronic acid are combined with gold. 
Gives rich nutrition and moisture to rough skin. 
An essence that creates moisture film to moisturize and smooth skin. 
Spread the right amount evenly over your face.
